original_card.question: Can one selected pricing or assembly claim be checked by a genuinely independent exact implementation?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls.

first_step.inspect: Record the selected certificate and complex_profile rather than taking a PR headline as input.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Recompute one small part of the ledger or one certified enclosure using an independent implementation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: Donor-assigned simplicity objective: define an Occam (simplicity/elegance) metric for a certified composition and find a strictly simpler construction with kappa at least the selected value. The independent part is an exact re-derivation of both bit suppliers' c from their words and of the selected 47-constraint outer assembly.
scope_change_reason: The donor asked to optimize simplicity at fixed-or-better kappa instead of the bound itself. The card's independent exact pricing is the tool used to prove kappa invariance; the new question is which parts of the selected construction pay rent in kappa.
bottleneck_link: Side result for the bottleneck: kappa = a/(1+a) with a = min(bit, complex), so effort on the non-binding supplier buys nothing. The ledger measures that waste (bit headroom 3.44%, 0.0216% of it bought by PR589 tuning) and shows the description cost is dominated 250:1 by the complex owner map, which directs simplification and review effort.
stop_rule: Stop at the first strictly Occam-simpler composition with exactly equal kappa and all inherited checks, or record which searched/frozen components are load-bearing; do not lower kappa (the conservative surcharge model, -2.85e-12, is reported, not taken).
evidence: verify.py (3 s, stdlib): reproduces all 47 selected outer constraint values exactly with PR589 c and gets identical kappa 0.001672660197076918 and constraints with PR555 c; both words replayed exactly and both c values re-derived by two exact engines. regenerate.py (19 s, numpy): searched-parameter rent controls. Cold replay of research/e8-bit-p111/verify.sh on this base (Python 3.13.16, g++ 13.3, Boost 1.83): PASS in 387 s, nine-stage c 0.001733052823330162099157, H1-H5 lemma and all controls.

ai_assistance: Claude Code (Anthropic), agentic: repository exploration, experiment design, verifier code and write-up; reviewed by the account owner.

open_questions.question: Can the complex owner map (69,120 roles, about 6.6 Mbit DEFLATE, about 98% of the frozen description) be replaced by a short structured rule with the same idle profile?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is where nearly all Occam length lives; a rule-generated witness with an equal profile keeps kappa exactly and makes the construction reviewable.
open_questions.first_step: Measure conditional structure (replica/stage periodicity; family is a function of (child, copy) and port of copy) and try a deterministic first-fit owner rule on the T16 window geometry, checking only the profile first.
open_questions.blocked_by: The strict T16 admission needs the PR1018/PR1005 local replay chain; a profile match alone is not admission.

open_questions.question: Can the 3.44% bit headroom buy removal of the H1-H5 interleaved-interface obligation?
open_questions.why_it_matters: An H1-H5-free bit word with nine-stage c above 0.0016754627 would drop a named conditional premise at unchanged kappa.
open_questions.first_step: Price PR545's punctured R489 word (passes PR493's interface) at nine stages with banks, since R = 489 exceeds the R <= 4v whole-hosting wall.
open_questions.blocked_by: The parameterised nine-stage chain hosts residuals whole only (no bank path for R > 4v).
